About

Company NameHebei Xingtai GuXiao Rubber Products Co., Ltd.
Introduction of this siteXingtai GuXiao Rubber Products Co., Ltd. is a professional automotive rubber parts manufacturer , specializing in the production of high-quality rubber components for steering systems, suspension systems, drivetrain systems, engine sealing systems, and hydraulic applications .

Located in Tiankou Town, Renxian County, Xingtai City, Hebei Province, China, our factory focuses on precision manufacturing of critical rubber parts such as CV Joint Boots, Driveshaft Boots, Steering Rack Boots, Shock Absorber Boots, Stabilizer Bar Bushings, Rubber O-Rings, and Valve Cover Gaskets .

With in-depth experience in OEM & ODM custom rubber parts manufacturing , we provide both standard automotive rubber components and fully customized solutions based on drawings, samples, or application requirements.

Our products are widely used for oil leak prevention, dust protection, sealing performance enhancement, and NVH reduction , helping improve vehicle reliability and service life under harsh operating conditions.

As a China-based source manufacturer, we operate our own production facility and supply automotive rubber parts directly to customers worldwide, without unnecessary middlemen or trading company markups. By working directly with our factory, importers, wholesalers, and distributors can benefit from competitive factory-direct pricing, efficient communication, flexible customization, and reliable production support. We are committed to providing cost-effective manufacturing solutions, helping our customers reduce sourcing costs, improve profit margins, and build long-term business partnerships.
